searchText: We did have a substantial number of slashings on Altona: https://altona.beaconcha.in/validators/slashings I wonder if these were analyzed? Are they all related to user error (starting to clients?) or were there some client bugs? There was an accidental whale that joined. I believe most are his and purposeful One nice thing for the next testnet might be to automatically open a github issue for each slashed validator, to streamline validation oh wait not the recent ones many of the recent ones have been writing "nimbus" in graffiti the attestation slashings in the ~2000 val index range were that whale recent ones are are low indices. Def a client team <@!570268431522201601> <@!553610810652622860> do you know whats going on here? anyone tracking those down? we are now 🙂 🙂 <@!399309815517544451> we had many ~9 days ago that were in the ~900 range. Was that the accidental whale as well? the whale was in the 2000s no thats p2p.org anyone have a contact with them? Nimbus does something fun: if you run both a VC and a BN with default settings, it loads validators into both. Not sure if they also run double, but it's risky
